question_text: What is the purpose and origin of the data?
answer_summary: EHRSQL was created as a benchmark for trustworthy question-answering systems over structured electronic health record data. Its primary purpose is to support research on trustworthy semantic parsing and text-to-SQL question answering in the healthcare domain.

question_text: What data-preparation processing operations took place?
answer_summary: Patient hospital records were manually time-shifted to support questions containing relative temporal expressions. A random time point between 2100 and 2105 was selected as the first hospital visit, and the complete patient record was shifted while preserving intervals between events. The number of current patients was constrained to 10% of the sampled population.

question_text: What data gaps and shortcomings are there in the data?
answer_summary: Several preprocessing assumptions can introduce inaccuracies. MIMIC-III does not provide original diagnosis and procedure timestamps, so diagnosis time is set to hospital admission time and procedure time to hospital discharge time. Patient records are also shuffled across patients for de-identification, which can disrupt the original longitudinal patient context. In addition, template-based question generation can produce unnatural or grammatically incorrect questions depending on the inserted values.
